entries.evidence_source: data/research/adaptive_ensemble/d22_r1/09_index_raw_manifest.json
entries.exact_supported_claim: The revalidated index contains exactly one non-attestation descriptor for linux/amd64 with no variant.
entries.unsupported_claims: Application compatibility on that CPU remains unverified.
entries.required_next_evidence: None for the OCI platform label. Application compatibility needs a later stage.

entries.evidence_source: The platform raw manifest and its parent index descriptor.
entries.exact_supported_claim: The raw manifest digest and byte count match the parent descriptor.
entries.unsupported_claims: Matching manifest bytes do not verify image configuration contents or runtime behaviour.
entries.required_next_evidence: Config-blob verification under a separate approval.

entries.evidence_source: The config object inside the revalidated platform manifest.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Media type, digest, and size of the referenced config blob are present and syntactically valid.
entries.unsupported_claims: The config blob bytes and their JSON contents remain unverified.
entries.required_next_evidence: A separately approved blob retrieval of this exact digest.

entries.evidence_source: Authorised D.22-R1 evidence contains manifest bytes only.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No config-blob byte identity is available locally.
entries.unsupported_claims: Descriptor identity is not blob-byte identity.
entries.required_next_evidence: Preserve the exact blob bytes and compare SHA-256 and size.

entries.evidence_source: No local config blob.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Config JSON schema and contents were not inspected.
entries.unsupported_claims: A valid descriptor does not validate config contents.
entries.required_next_evidence: Parse the blob only after its digest matches.

entries.evidence_source: Manifest annotation and the mutable Dockerfile tag name the Python image family.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No measured interpreter implementation is present in the preserved bytes.
entries.unsupported_claims: The image name does not prove CPython or another implementation.
entries.required_next_evidence: Config labels may be class A evidence. A measured interpreter requires class C.

entries.evidence_source: org.opencontainers.image.version inside the revalidated manifest annotations.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Both manifests contain the literal annotation string 3.12.15-slim-bookworm.
entries.unsupported_claims: That annotation is not a measured Python patch version and was not confirmed from config or filesystem bytes.
entries.required_next_evidence: Separate config-blob and, if the config lacks a measured version, filesystem or runtime evidence.

entries.evidence_source: No ABI field in the preserved manifests.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No Python ABI tag is present.
entries.unsupported_claims: Architecture and a 3.12 tag do not establish an ABI such as cp312.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class B or class C evidence.

entries.evidence_source: Manifest annotation org.opencontainers.image.base.name and the Dockerfile tag.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Both manifests contain the literal base-name string debian:bookworm-slim.
entries.unsupported_claims: The annotation and codename do not prove the image filesystem release.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class A labels if present, otherwise class B package metadata.

entries.evidence_source: No package-status bytes are preserved.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No Debian package revision was extracted.
entries.unsupported_claims: A base-image digest annotation is not a verified package revision.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class B package metadata.

entries.evidence_source: The bookworm codename appears only as an image name annotation.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No libc family was read from a library or package.
entries.unsupported_claims: Bookworm does not by itself establish glibc or another libc family.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class B inspection of the runtime loader and packages.

entries.evidence_source: No libc version string is present in the preserved manifests.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No libc version was verified.
entries.unsupported_claims: A Debian codename does not supply a libc version.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class B or class C version evidence.

entries.evidence_source: R01 records the OCI platform. Compatibility was not tested.
entries.exact_supported_claim: The image descriptor names the architecture. Bot and wheel compatibility were not tested.
entries.unsupported_claims: An OCI architecture label does not prove native-library compatibility.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class D wheels and class E hardware evidence.

entries.evidence_source: Layer descriptors were recorded and not retrieved.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No shared-library requirement was inspected.
entries.unsupported_claims: Layer digests do not identify sonames or versions.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class B library inspection after a separate approval.

entries.evidence_source: D.17 native-wheel matrix and the unpinned requirements file.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No wheel tag was selected for this platform.
entries.unsupported_claims: CPU architecture alone does not select a compatible wheel.
entries.required_next_evidence: A later architecture-specific wheel review.

entries.evidence_source: Dockerfile contains no USER instruction. Config JSON was not read.
entries.exact_supported_claim: The project Dockerfile does not declare a user. The base-image user is inside the unread config blob.
entries.unsupported_claims: Absence of a USER instruction does not identify the image user.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class A config.User after blob verification.

entries.evidence_source: Dockerfile ENV instructions, lines 6-10.
entries.exact_supported_claim: The Dockerfile declares PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, PYTHONUNBUFFERED, and three pip settings for a future image build.
entries.unsupported_claims: The declaration does not prove a built container environment.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class A config.Env for the base image, and a built-image check for the project settings.

entries.evidence_source: Dockerfile contains no ENTRYPOINT. Config JSON was not read.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No image entrypoint was verified.
entries.unsupported_claims: The project command does not identify the base-image entrypoint.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class A config.Entrypoint after blob verification.

entries.evidence_source: Dockerfile line 81.
entries.exact_supported_claim: The Dockerfile declares CMD uvicorn forex_bot.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000.
entries.unsupported_claims: The declaration does not prove the base-image command or that a container runs it.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class A config.Cmd for the base image. The project command remains a source declaration until an image is built under a later approval.

entries.evidence_source: Dockerfile contains no HEALTHCHECK.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No health behaviour was verified.
entries.unsupported_claims: EXPOSE 8000 does not define health behaviour.
entries.required_next_evidence: A later runtime test under a separate approval.

entries.evidence_source: No candidate image or application execution in this stage.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Application compatibility with either base image is unverified.
entries.unsupported_claims: Manifest identity does not prove the bot runs.
entries.required_next_evidence: Isolated runtime testing after image construction is separately approved.

entries.evidence_source: Historical live-order authorisation is BLOCKED. Current production authorisation was not independently verified.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Live-safety behaviour was not tested.
entries.unsupported_claims: This planning stage cannot authorise a live-safety trial.
entries.required_next_evidence: Production safety review remains separately blocked.

entries.evidence_source: D.21 records VPS hardware as outside the approved policy scope.
entries.exact_supported_claim: No production VPS compatibility evidence was collected.
entries.unsupported_claims: An intended platform policy does not identify the current VPS.
entries.required_next_evidence: Class E evidence under a separate approval.

entries.evidence_source: Digest equality against the preserved D.22-R1 registry digest. Attestation descriptors were not retrieved.
entries.exact_supported_claim: Byte identity relative to the preserved references is established for the index and two manifests.
entries.unsupported_claims: Digest equality does not establish publisher authenticity, signatures, or a rollback artifact.
entries.required_next_evidence: A separate provenance and signature review.
